messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High 5xx error spike observed on /v2/generate (service: inference-proxy, model: rwd-v5-quant-pt). Error rate 5xx=23% over 2m, total qps=1200. Potential perf regress after last hot deploy.

Oncall - SRE: I'm taking. Paging +1. Anyone saw this in console? :eyes:

Maria Chen: Seeing increased p99 latency too. Rolling kv cache misses going up on nodes serving rwd-v5-quant-pt.

Dan Ortiz: Confirmed. Top 2 error messages are OOM on gpu worker and 'kv cache miss path unsupported for quantized kernel'. Could be new kernel mismatch.

Kevin Patel: Was there a canary roll earlier? I see a canary rollout finished 10m ago for rwd-v5-quant-pt -> 8% traffic.

Oncall - SRE: Ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) Freeze the rwd-v5-quant-pt variant (stop routing new keys), 2) Enforce per-key emergency throttles for heavy keys, 3) Reroute traffic to rwd-v4-stable and rwd-v5-fallback, 4) Notify customers with degraded latencies. Executing step 1 now.

Oncall - SRE: /infra route freeze --model rwd-v5-quant-pt --reason "pager high 5xx" --dry=false

ops-bot: Command accepted. Routing freeze started for rwd-v5-quant-pt across us-east-1/us-west-2. ETA 15s.

Maria Chen: I pushed a temporary traffic-shaping rule to shift canary traffic -> rwd-v4-stable. Snippet:

```
route_policy:
  match: model=="rwd-v5-quant-pt" && env==prod
  action:
    redirect: ["rwd-v4-stable","rwd-v5-fallback"]
    split: [0.85,0.15]
``` 

Dan Ortiz: Also adding emergency quota clamp for keys with >100 req/s to reduce cascade.

Kevin Patel: How do we apply per-key throttle? I can run a patch on rate-limiter.

Paul Nguyen: I'll push per-key limit patch: /deploy rate-limiter --patch "emergency_clamp=100" --scope=prod --note "pager response"

ops-bot: Deploy started: rate-limiter patch (deploy id: dl-7921). Rolling across 6 regions.

Oncall - SRE: Monitoring: error-rate dropping to 6% after freeze, but some long tail customers are still seeing 429s. Need to identify heavy keys.

Maria Chen: Querying logs for top 20 api_keys by 5xx in last 5m... sending list.

Maria Chen: Top offenders: acct-acme-01 (42% of 5xx), acct-dataforge (18%), acct-mlhub (11%). Acme has a large batch job running.

Dan Ortiz: For AcmeAnalytics (acct-acme-01) reached out to SE channel earlier; suggest contacting them to ask to pause bulk batch or we throttle them to 30rps.

Oncall - SRE: Applying key-level throttle for acct-acme-01 to 30rps immediately.

Oncall - SRE: /quota set acct-acme-01 --rate 30

ops-bot: Quota updated for acct-acme-01 -> 30rps.

Kevin Patel: Good. Also let's set global soft 429 threshold at 15% to avoid unhealthy cascade.

Oncall - SRE: Added an alert rule to auto-scale fallback capacity and notify if 429>15% for 3m.

Maria Chen: Post-mitigation notes: rwd-v5-quant-pt is frozen, ~94% of traffic now on rwd-v4-stable, overall 5xx down to 1.2%, p50 latency stable, p99 improved but still 2x baseline.

Dan Ortiz: Root cause hypothesis: kernel selection for quantized variant misaligned with new dim-morphism change in last model push. Need offline repro and rollback of the model artifact.

Oncall - SRE: For now leave freeze in place. We will roll back the model artifact in staging and run validation suite before re-enabling.

Maria Chen: Action items: (1) Kevin to run artifact rollback test and perf-run (2) Dan to capture detailed kv-cache metrics and heap dumps (3) Paul to update customer comms and SEs. I'll own postmortem.

Kevin Patel: Starting rollback validation: pulling prior artifact rwd-v5-quant-pt@sha256:8f3a2c

Kevin Patel: Perf-run shows no OOM and successful kv cache hits at similar QPS in staging. If green I'll prepare a safe variant rwd-v5-quant-pt-rollback for canary.

Oncall - SRE: Timeline: immediate freeze + throttles applied. ETA for safe canary rollout after validation ~45m. Leaving oncall to Dan for 30m check.

Dan Ortiz: Taking handoff. Will monitor API dashboard, contact SEs for customer outreach.

Oncall - SRE: Handoff ack. If anything degrades escalate to paging list.

Paul Nguyen: Notifying customers: posting incident note to status with short message and targeted emails to AcmeAnalytics and DataForge.

Paul Nguyen: Draft message: "We are investigating elevated errors on generation-v2 for a model variant; we've temporarily routed traffic to a stable variant and applied throttles to heavy keys. You may see 429s. We expect resolution within 1 hour. Contact support@redwoodai.com for urgent impact." Want approvals.

Maria Chen: LGTM. Send.

Paul Nguyen: Sent. Status page updated.

incident-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: affected endpoints: /v2/generate, model variant: rwd-v5-quant-pt (frozen), mitigation: routing freeze, per-key throttles, rate-limiter patch deployed. Next update in 30m.

Dan Ortiz: Monitoring looks stable. Closing active mitigation window but keeping freeze until postmortem. Will create follow-ups in #postmortems with detailed logs.

Maria Chen: Postmortem card created: PM-5789. Assigned to Maria, Dan, Kevin.

Oncall - SRE: last call: leave routing freeze AND per-key clamps until we validate rollback and run housekeeper to re-enable once we confirm kv-cache compatibility.

Paul Nguyen: Noted. I'll coordinate customer follow-ups and escalation docs.

Dan Ortiz: closing thread here, will update on PM-5789. Thanks everyone.
